oracle_policy: Expected behavior is authored from the case contracts and fixture declarations; engine output is never used to define expected output.

cases.profile: TSProfile typescript_javascript; plugins disabled; captured config and declaration closure
cases.capability: Typed local alias, re-export, scope and project-reference bindings; unresolved JS any and dynamic imports remain gaps.

cases.profile: TSProfile typescript_javascript with captured frontend files and approved service binding
cases.capability: Route, client and handler links require typed source evidence and service namespace; equal path strings alone do not bind.

cases.profile: PythonProfile syntax or typed_when_available with pinned CPython and standard library
cases.capability: Captured AST definitions preserve lexical scope and byte ranges; imports, decorators, monkey patches and dynamic execution remain unknown.

cases.profile: PythonProfile with bounded notebook metadata reader
cases.capability: Notebook metadata is read as captured JSON; code cells, startup hooks, virtual environments and outputs are not executed or treated as facts.

cases.profile: Explicit MySQL dialect and engine profile
cases.capability: Static schema, object lineage and literal SQL are source-bound; dynamic SQL and unknown session modes retain gaps.

cases.profile: Captured OpenAPI, JSON Schema and Proto declarations with explicit local reference limits
cases.capability: Local versioned fields and explicitly verified handlers are distinguished from remote, cyclic, unresolved or declaration-only references.

cases.profile: Captured AsyncAPI/cache declarations with broker, environment and version namespace
cases.capability: Producer/consumer links require explicit matching evidence; retries, acknowledgements, replay and delivery guarantees remain declaration-only.

cases.profile: Approved captured mce4d-state-model-v1 record at a pinned scope
cases.capability: Declarations and approved constraints are checked statically; guards and actions are not run and stale approvals do not authorize reads.

cases.profile: Explicit group membership, pinned member snapshots and contract bridge
cases.capability: Cross-service traversal follows declared, source-bound links only; stale or denied members remain partial and withhold source.

cases.profile: Two retained, exact profile/provider and generation snapshots
cases.capability: Diff preserves ambiguity, provider changes and missing generations; it does not fall back to latest.

cases.profile: Approved trading profile with declared precision and state evidence
cases.capability: Reserve, retry, partial fill, cancel and ledger obligations remain evidence-bound; money precision and finality are never inferred from names.

cases.profile: Approved commerce profile with separate order, payment and stock states
cases.capability: Duplicate/out-of-order webhooks and partial refunds preserve separate state machines and only verified consumers.

cases.profile: Captured mce4d-ai-lineage-v1 metadata with pinned scope and source hashes
cases.capability: Model, prompt, tokenizer, dataset, index and evaluation metadata are compared without loading rows, weights or checkpoints or calling a model.

cases.profile: Approved captured architecture declaration and observed provider coverage
cases.capability: Dependency witnesses and exemptions include exact sources; unsupported providers keep the result incomplete.

cases.profile: Authored synthetic fixtures with independent expected facts and explicit mode boundaries
cases.capability: The closed matrix maps every case to an existing acceptance test; incremental claims are limited to verified Go invalidation and retained snapshot comparison.

baseline.oracle: Expected facts are authored from source fixture contracts and are independent of analyzer output.

full.meaning: Run every listed domain/provider acceptance test against its complete authored capture.

incremental.scope: Verified incremental behavior is limited to Go index invalidation and retained-snapshot semantic comparison. TS, Python, contract and domain providers analyze a new captured generation; no incremental provider-cache claim is made for them.

benchmark.rule: No token savings or real-repository performance claim without an authorized host export and a real repository cohort.
